subject: Mythology
title: The Birth of the Sun Goddess
description: A quick win: understand The Birth of the Sun Goddess.

hook.text: After escaping the underworld, Izanagi washed his face and accidentally created three of the most powerful gods.

buildup.text: From his left eye came Amaterasu, goddess of the sun. From his right eye, Tsukuyomi, god of the moon.

discovery.text: From his nose came Susanoo, the wild storm god who would cause chaos in heaven and earth alike.

twist.text: Izanagi gave Amaterasu rule over heaven, making a woman the supreme deity in Japanese mythology.

climax.text: The Japanese imperial family claims direct descent from Amaterasu, a lineage they maintain to this day.

punchline.text: A bath after a trip to hell created the goddess who rules Japan to this day.

quiz.question: How was Amaterasu, the sun goddess, born?
options: She emerged from a golden egg at the dawn of time
Izanagi washed his left eye after escaping the underworld
She was the first child of Izanagi and Izanami
